shloka_text: अवाङ्मुखमथो दीनं दृष्ट्वा सोममिवाप्लुतम् । राघवं लक्ष्मणो वाक्यं हृष्टो मधुरमब्रवीत् ।। 7.106.1 ।।
transliteration: avāṅmukhamatho dīnaṃ dṛṣṭvā somamivāplutam | rāghavaṃ lakṣmaṇo vākyaṃ hṛṣṭo madhuramabravīt || 7.106.1 ||
translation: अवाङ्मुखम् with face downwards, अथो then, दीनम् distressed, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सोमम् the moon, इव like, आप्लुतम् submerged (in sorrow), राघवम् Rama, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, वाक्यम् words, हृष्टः with resolve, मधुरम् gentle, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Seeing Rama with his face downcast and distressed, like the moon submerged in sorrow, Lakshmana, with a firm resolve, spoke gentle words to him.
comments: Lakshmana, understanding, bids Rama abandon him to keep his vow lest dharma itself perish, and the council and Vasishtha confirm that the parting was foreseen and must be borne for the worlds' sake -- Rama gives him up, and Lakshmana goes to the Sarayu, stills his breath, and is taken bodily to heaven by Indra as the fourth part of Vishnu, honoured by the gods.

shloka_text: न संतापं महाबाहो मदर्थं कर्तुमर्हसि । पूर्वनिर्माणबद्धा हि कालस्य गतिरीदृशी ।। 7.106.2 ।।
transliteration: na saṃtāpaṃ mahābāho madarthaṃ kartumarhasi | pūrvanirmāṇabaddhā hi kālasya gatirīdṛśī || 7.106.2 ||
translation: न not, संतापम् sorrow, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, मदर्थम् for my sake, कर्तुम् to make, अर्हसि you ought, पूर्वनिर्माणबद्धा bound by previous destiny, हि indeed, कालस्य of time, गतिः the course, ईदृशी such.
explanation: O mighty-armed one, you should not grieve for my sake, for such is indeed the course of time, bound by preordained destiny.

shloka_text: जहि मां सौम्य विस्रब्धं प्रतिज्ञां परिपालय । हीनप्रतिज्ञाः काकुत्स्थ प्रयान्ति नरकं नराः ।। 7.106.3 ।।
transliteration: jahi māṃ saumya visrabdhaṃ pratijñāṃ paripālaya | hīnapratijñāḥ kākutstha prayānti narakaṃ narāḥ || 7.106.3 ||
translation: जहि kill/abandon, माम् me, सौम्य O gentle one, विस्रब्धम् confidently, प्रतिज्ञाम् the vow, परिपालय fulfill, हीनप्रतिज्ञाः those who fail in their vows, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, प्रयान्ति go, नरकम् to hell, नराः men.
explanation: O gentle one, confidently abandon me and fulfill your vow, for men who fail in their promises, O Kakutstha, go to hell.

shloka_text: यदि प्रीतिर्महाराज यद्यनुग्राह्यता मयि । जहि मां निर्विशङ्कस्त्वं धर्मं वर्धय राघव ।। 7.106.4 ।।
transliteration: yadi prītirmahārāja yadyanugrāhyatā mayi | jahi māṃ nirviśaṅkastvaṃ dharmaṃ vardhaya rāghava || 7.106.4 ||
translation: यदि if, प्रीतिः affection, महाराज O great king, यदि if, अनुग्राह्यता favor, मयि in me, जहि kill/abandon, माम् me, निर्विशङ्कः without doubt, त्वम् you, धर्मम् righteousness, वर्धय uphold, राघव O Raghava.
explanation: O great king, if there is affection and favor towards me, then abandon me without hesitation, O Raghava, and uphold your dharma.

shloka_text: लक्ष्मणेन तथोक्तस्तु रामः प्रचलितेन्द्रियः । मन्त्रिणः समुपानीय तथैव च पुरोधसम् ।। 7.106.5 ।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇena tathoktastu rāmaḥ pracalitendriyaḥ | mantriṇaḥ samupānīya tathaiva ca purodhasam || 7.106.5 ||
translation: लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, तथा thus, उक्तः spoken, तु indeed, रामः Rama, प्रचलितेन्द्रियः with agitated senses, मन्त्रिणः the ministers, समुपानीय having summoned, तथैव and similarly, च and, पुरोधसम् the chief priest.
explanation: Thus spoken to by Lakshmana, Rama, with his senses greatly disturbed, summoned his ministers and similarly his chief priest.

shloka_text: अब्रवीच्च तदा वृत्तं तेषां मध्ये स राघवः । दुर्वासोभिगमं चैव प्रतिज्ञां तापसस्य च ।। 7.106.6 ।।
transliteration: abravīcca tadā vṛttaṃ teṣāṃ madhye sa rāghavaḥ | durvāsobhigamaṃ caiva pratijñāṃ tāpasasya ca || 7.106.6 ||
translation: अब्रवीत् spoke, च and, तदा then, वृत्तम् the incident, तेषाम् among them, मध्ये in the midst, सः he, राघवः Rama, दुर्वासोभिगमम् the arrival of Durvasa, च and, एव also, प्रतिज्ञाम् the vow, तापसस्य of the ascetic, च and.
explanation: Then, in their midst, Rama recounted the incident, including the arrival of Durvasa and the ascetic's vow.

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा मन्त्रिणः सर्वे सोपाध्यायाः समासत । वसिष्ठस्तु महातेजा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.106.7 ।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā mantriṇaḥ sarve sopādhyāyāḥ samāsata | vasiṣṭhastu mahātejā vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.106.7 ||
translation: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, मन्त्रिणः the ministers, सर्वे all, सोपाध्यायाः with their preceptors, समासत assembled, वसिष्ठः Vasishtha, तु indeed, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.
explanation: Having heard that, all the ministers, along with their preceptors, assembled, and then the greatly effulgent Vasishtha spoke these words.

shloka_text: दृष्टमेतन्महाबाहो क्षयं ते रोमहर्षणम् । लक्ष्मणेन वियोगश्च तव राम महायशः ।। 7.106.8 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭametanmahābāho kṣayaṃ te romaharṣaṇam | lakṣmaṇena viyogaśca tava rāma mahāyaśaḥ || 7.106.8 ||
translation: दृष्टम् foreseen, एतत् this, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, क्षयम् destruction, ते your, रोमहर्षणम् terrifying, लक्ष्मणेन with Lakshmana, वियोगः separation, च and, तव your, राम O Rama, महायशः O greatly renowned one.
explanation: O mighty-armed and greatly renowned Rama, this terrifying destruction and your separation from Lakshmana have been foreseen.

shloka_text: त्यजैनं बलवान्कालो मा प्रतिज्ञां वृथा कृताः । विनष्टायां प्रतिज्ञायां धर्मो ऽपि च लयं व्रजेत् ।। 7.106.9 ।।
transliteration: tyajainaṃ balavānkālo mā pratijñāṃ vṛthā kṛtāḥ | vinaṣṭāyāṃ pratijñāyāṃ dharmo 'pi ca layaṃ vrajet || 7.106.9 ||
translation: त्यज abandon, एनम् him, बलवान् powerful, कालः time/fate, मा do not, प्रतिज्ञाम् the vow, वृथा in vain, कृताः made; विनष्टायाम् if violated, प्रतिज्ञायाम् the vow, धर्मः righteousness, अपि even, च and, लयम् dissolution, व्रजेत् would attain.
explanation: Abandon him, for time is powerful; do not let your vow be made in vain, because if the vow is violated, even righteousness will meet its dissolution.

shloka_text: ततो धर्मे विनष्टे तु त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् । सदेवर्षिगणं सर्वं विनश्येत्तु न संशयः ।। 7.106.10 ।।
transliteration: tato dharme vinaṣṭe tu trailokyaṃ sacarācaram | sadevarṣigaṇaṃ sarvaṃ vinaśyettu na saṃśayaḥ || 7.106.10 ||
translation: ततः then, धर्मे righteousness, विनष्टे having been destroyed, तु indeed, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds, सचराचरम् with moving and non-moving beings, सदेवर्षिगणम् with groups of gods and sages, सर्वम् all, विनश्येत् would be destroyed, तु indeed, न not, संशयः doubt.
explanation: Therefore, if righteousness is destroyed, then without a doubt, all three worlds, including all moving and non-moving beings, along with the groups of gods and sages, would also be destroyed.

shloka_text: स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल त्रैलोक्यस्याभिपालनात् । लक्ष्मणेन विना चाद्य जगत्स्वस्थं कुरुष्व ह ।। 7.106.11 ।।
transliteration: sa tvaṃ puruṣaśārdūla trailokyasyābhipālanāt | lakṣmaṇena vinā cādya jagatsvasthaṃ kuruṣva ha || 7.106.11 ||
translation: स that, त्वं you, पुरुषशार्दूल O tiger among men, त्रैलोक्यस्य of the three worlds, अभिपालनात् for the protection, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, विना without, च and, अद्य today, जगत् the world, स्वस्थं well, कुरुष्व make, ह indeed
explanation: O tiger among men, for the protection of the three worlds, you must now make the world stable even without Lakshmana.

shloka_text: तेषां तत्समवेतानां वाक्यं धर्मार्थसंहितम् । श्रुत्वा परिषदो मध्ये रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत् ।। 7.106.12 ।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ tatsamavetānāṃ vākyaṃ dharmārthasaṃhitam | śrutvā pariṣado madhye rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt || 7.106.12 ||
translation: तेषां of them, तत्समवेतानां who were assembled there, वाक्यं the words, धर्मार्थसंहितम् endowed with righteousness and purpose, श्रुत्वा having heard, परिषदो of the assembly, मध्ये in the midst, रामः Rama, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: Having heard the words full of righteousness and purpose from those assembled in the midst of the council, Rama spoke to Lakshmana.

shloka_text: विसर्जये त्वां सौमित्रे मा भूद्धर्मविपर्ययः । त्यागो वधो वा विहितः साधूनां तूभयं समम् ।। 7.106.13 ।।
transliteration: visarjaye tvāṃ saumitre mā bhūddharmaviparyayaḥ | tyāgo vadho vā vihitaḥ sādhūnāṃ tūbhayaṃ samam || 7.106.13 ||
translation: विसर्जये I shall abandon, त्वां you, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, मा do not, भूत् let there be, धर्मविपर्ययः a transgression of dharma, त्यागः abandonment, वधः killing, वा or, विहितः prescribed, साधूनां for the virtuous, तु but, उभयं both, समम् equal
explanation: O son of Sumitra, I shall abandon you, lest there be a transgression of dharma, for abandonment or killing is prescribed, and for the virtuous, both are considered equal.

shloka_text: रामेण भाषिते वाक्ये बाष्पव्याकुलितेन्द्रियः । लक्ष्मणस्त्वरितं प्रायात्स्वगृहं न विवेश ह ।। 7.106.14 ।।
transliteration: rāmeṇa bhāṣite vākye bāṣpavyākulitendriyaḥ | lakṣmaṇastvaritaṃ prāyātsvagṛhaṃ na viveśa ha || 7.106.14 ||
translation: रामेण by Rama, भाषिते having been spoken, वाक्ये the words, बाष्पव्याकुलितेन्द्रियः whose senses were agitated by tears, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, त्वरितं quickly, प्रायात् departed, स्वगृहं his own house, न not, विवेश entered, ह indeed
explanation: When these words were spoken by Rama, Lakshmana, whose senses were agitated by tears, quickly departed and indeed did not enter his own house.

shloka_text: स गत्वा सरयूतीरमुपस्पृश्य कृताञ्जलिः । निगृह्य सर्वस्रोतांसि निःश्वासं न मुमोच ह ।। 7.106.15 ।।
transliteration: sa gatvā sarayūtīramupaspṛśya kṛtāñjaliḥ | nigṛhya sarvasrotāṃsi niḥśvāsaṃ na mumoca ha || 7.106.15 ||
translation: सः he, गत्वा having gone, सरयूतीरम् to the bank of the Sarayu, उपस्पृश्य having touched water, कृताञ्जलिः having made an anjali, निगृह्य having restrained, सर्वस्रोतांसि all the streams (of his senses/life-breaths), निःश्वासं breath, न not, मुमोच released, ह indeed
explanation: Having gone to the bank of the Sarayu, he performed ritual purification, folded his hands in reverence, and restraining all his vital breaths, he indeed did not release a single exhalation.

shloka_text: अनिःश्वसन्तं युक्तं तं सशक्राः साप्सरोगणाः । देवाः सर्षिगणाः सर्वे पुष्पैरभ्यकिरंस्तदा ।। 7.106.16 ।।
transliteration: aniḥśvasantaṃ yuktaṃ taṃ saśakrāḥ sāpsarogaṇāḥ | devāḥ sarṣigaṇāḥ sarve puṣpairabhyakiraṃstadā || 7.106.16 ||
translation: अनिःश्वसन्तं not breathing, युक्तं absorbed, तं him, सशक्राः with Indra, साप्सरोगणाः with groups of Apsaras, देवाः gods, सर्षिगणाः with groups of sages, सर्वे all, पुष्पैरभ्यकिरन् showered with flowers, तदा then.
explanation: Then, all the gods, along with Indra, groups of Apsaras, and groups of sages, showered flowers upon him (Lakshmana), who was absorbed (in his divine form) and had ceased breathing.

shloka_text: अदृश्यं सर्वमनुजैः सशरीरं महाबलम् । प्रगृह्य लक्ष्मणं शक्रस्त्रिदिवं संविवेश ह ।। 7.106.17 ।।
transliteration: adṛśyaṃ sarvamanujaiḥ saśarīraṃ mahābalam | pragṛhya lakṣmaṇaṃ śakrastridivaṃ saṃviveśa ha || 7.106.17 ||
translation: अदृश्यं invisible, सर्वमनुजैः to all humans, सशरीरं with his body, महाबलम् the mighty one, प्रगृह्य taking, लक्ष्मणं Lakshmana, शक्रः Indra, त्रिदिवं to heaven, संविवेश entered, ह indeed.
explanation: Indeed, Indra took the mighty Lakshmana, who was invisible to all humans and still in his physical body, and entered heaven.

shloka_text: ततो विष्णोश्चतुर्भागमागतं सुरसत्तमाः । दृष्ट्वा प्रमुदिताः सर्वे ऽपूजयन् समहर्षयः ।। 7.106.18 ।।
transliteration: tato viṣṇoścaturbhāgamāgataṃ surasattamāḥ | dṛṣṭvā pramuditāḥ sarve 'pūjayan samaharṣayaḥ || 7.106.18 ||
translation: ततः then, विष्णोः of Vishnu, चतुर्भागम् the fourth part, आगतं arrived, सुरसत्तमाः the best of gods, दृष्ट्वा having seen, प्रमुदिताः greatly delighted, सर्वे all, अपूजयन् worshipped, समहर्षयः with the great sages.
explanation: Then, having seen the fourth part of Vishnu (Lakshmana) arrive, all the best of gods, along with the great sages, were greatly delighted and worshipped him. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षडुत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। 106 ।। Thus ends the hundred and sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
